title: PIXEL FASHION TURNTABLE
why: Job 86c requires the same pixel body in FASHION previews at whole 4x with smoothing off. The shipped drawOp only enables pixels on the raid and Undercroft canvases, leaving the FASHION turntable in vector art.
now: The FASHION turntable shows the plain pixel pillager at 4x, centered in its existing canvas. The later wardrobe job still owns the rack tiles and full sets.
